protocol.safe_punctuation: After casefold and whitespace collapse, map internal U+2010/U+2011 to hyphen and U+2018/U+2019 to apostrophe, only between alphanumeric characters
protocol.lexical_input: raw strings; no RapidFuzz processor; PostgreSQL function arguments query, candidate
protocol.alias_aggregation: maximum permitted representation score per canonical ID; mask queried source ID before aggregation
protocol.search: exhaustive, all same-type candidates, no score threshold or approximate index
protocol.bootstrap_unit: canonical target; percentile intervals for micro recall and paired differences
protocol.query_features: raw tag name; observed type restricts candidate catalogue

postgres.server_version: PostgreSQL 18.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 16.2.1 20260810, 64-bit

embedding.normalization: L2 normalization and exhaustive dot products in float64
embedding.model_revision: Provider returned an unversioned model alias; checksummed vectors freeze this run

timings.interpretation: pg sums concurrent query elapsed times including ranking; other methods sum batch scoring wall times; these are not comparable serving latencies
